\section[o ambiente]{o ambiente — the environment}

\label{lesson:PT-C225-ambiente}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Portuguese for a vase, a jug, then the Portuguese for a plant.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: o ambiente}
\textbf{o ambiente} — \textquotedblleft{}the environment\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{ambiente} $\leftarrow$ Latin \emph{ambiens, ambientis}, \textquotedblleft{}going around\textquotedblright{} (EtymDB 2.1), from \emph{ambire}, \textquotedblleft{}to go around\textquotedblright{} — a learned borrowing from Latin.
\end{cousinweb}
